market_name: Will 11 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market's implied probability move is corroborated by 2Y/10Y yield moves and Fed funds futures; confirm it isn't stale/thin-liquidity noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs. SOFR/Fed funds futures repricing; look for a macro headline (jobs, CPI, financial-stability event) driving the shift.
time_plan.2h: Re-assess whether the easing narrative is holding or fading; watch equity/credit spreads for confirmation of a risk-off/recession read.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether TLT sustained the move into US session liquidity; check for Fed speaker or data catalysts.
time_plan.12h: Mark final TLT return vs. entry; judge whether the prediction-market signal led the bond move or merely tracked it.

predictions.reasoning: A market pricing 11 (i.e. ~275bps) of Fed cuts in 2026 is a deep-easing / emergency-cut tail scenario. A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal expectations of a hard-landing recession or crisis forcing aggressive Fed easing, which drives front-end and long-end yields lower and long-duration Treasury prices higher. TLT is the most liquid clean proxy for falling policy-rate/duration expectations.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm gold move aligns with real-yield (TIPS) and DXY direction; rule out idiosyncratic gold-specific flows.
time_plan.1h: Check DXY and 10Y real yields for consistency with the easing signal.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether safe-haven bid is broad (gold, bonds, yen) or isolated.
time_plan.6h: Track whether gold holds gains through US session; watch for any Fed commentary.
time_plan.12h: Record final GLD return and whether it confirmed the deep-easing thesis.

predictions.reasoning: An aggressive-easing/crisis tail scenario implies lower real rates and a weaker dollar, both supportive for gold as a non-yielding safe-haven. If the 11-cut probability spikes, it typically coincides with risk-off and dovish repricing that lifts gold.

evidence_used: Market resolves on count of 25bps Fed cuts in 2026; 11 cuts (~275bps) is an extreme-easing tail requiring recession/emergency action
Description explicitly includes emergency inter-meeting cuts, reinforcing crisis-scenario interpretation
Standard macro linkage: aggressive Fed easing expectations lower yields (TLT up), weaken USD, and support gold
uncertainty_notes: An 11-cut outcome is a very low-probability tail; even a large proportional move in implied probability may reflect tiny absolute levels and thin liquidity
Equity direction is genuinely ambiguous (dovish tailwind vs. recession fear), so no equity prediction offered
The 700bps tradable threshold is far above realistic 12h moves for these liquid proxies — treat as research signal, not tradable

llm_justification.summary: This market prices an extreme deep-easing/emergency-cut scenario for the Fed in 2026. A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal expectations of a hard-landing or crisis forcing aggressive rate cuts, favoring long-duration Treasuries (TLT up) and gold (GLD up) via lower real rates, a weaker dollar, and safe-haven demand. Confidence is modest and expected magnitudes fall well below the 700bps tradable bar; treat as a noisy leading indicator, not a trade.
key_assumptions: A rise in the 11-cut probability reflects genuine deep-easing/crisis expectations rather than thin-market noise
Bond and gold markets have not already fully priced the same macro shift
Rate-cut expectations dominate the safe-haven/duration channels over the 12h window
failure_modes: Move is noise in an illiquid tail contract with near-zero absolute probability, implying no real macro information
The macro news was already public and assets already repriced before the market signal
Dovish easing could be read as bullish for risk, muddying/ reversing the safe-haven interpretation
TLT/GLD are only loosely tied to a specific cut-count contract; the proxy exposure is indirect
Expected 12h magnitudes are far below the 700bps tradable threshold, so the signal is non-actionable under the stated rule
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
